reply_text:
Gideon, you first reported it at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in this channel. The message said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.

The guard was logging trailer numbers by hand on a clipboard. The channel doesn't record anything else the guard did during the outage. Mateo posted at 10:44 that six trucks were waiting at the east gate.

At 11:03 Mateo said kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836 on it. You posted at 11:08 that both lanes were working as of 11:07. That makes the outage about 25 minutes from your report to full recovery.
